name: failure-fires-via-match-true
note: an empty input vector makes the cosine undefined, so the classifier fails; with on_error match_true the band counts as matched, so the rule fires and routes to CodingLLM. The trace entry has no score (the classifier failed) but result is true

name: success-below-threshold-misses
note: on_error only applies on failure; here the classifier succeeds with a real score of ~0.447, which is below the 0.5 threshold, so the band misses normally and routing falls back to default_model
